 Nevermind the Noise
 Nevermind the Noise, a collective of graduate composers, is committed to the composition and performance of new experimental concert music. 
 Nevermind the Noise is graduate composers collective committed to the composition and performance of new experimental concert music. Rather than exploring the repertoire of an established tradition, the group seeks to break down common conceptions of what music is while engaging the greater NYC community through collaborative art projects and performances. 
 Admission is free. Registration is required.
